resumeText:
Sanjay Kulkarni | Pune | sanjay.kulkarni@example.com

SUMMARY
Delivery manager in IT services with 14 years across development, project management and account delivery for insurance clients.

EXPERIENCE
Delivery Manager, Sahyadri Infotech Services, Pune (2020 - present)
- Own delivery for two insurance client accounts with six project teams in Pune and Chennai.
- Lead six project managers and 140 engineers across the two accounts.
- Manage account P&L and delivery margins for both accounts, including monthly billing and revenue forecasts.
- Run weekly program governance with RAID logs and dependency tracking across the six teams.
- Own headcount planning and fulfilment for both accounts with the central resourcing team.
- Handled client escalations after a failed policy-admin release and ran the recovery plan to closure.
- Moved three teams from waterfall to Scrum with two-week sprints.
- Run monthly delivery reviews with client IT heads and our account leadership team.
- Present quarterly delivery reviews to client leadership.

Project Manager, Sahyadri Infotech Services, Pune (2016 - 2020)
- Managed project plans, scope and schedules for a claims system rebuild using MS Project.
- Tracked effort and change requests for a team of 25.

Software Engineer, Deccan Code Works, Pune (2012 - 2016)
- Built Java services for an insurance quoting portal.

SKILLS
Delivery management, Pre-sales, Agile, Jira, MS Project

EDUCATION
BE Computer Engineering, Pune University, 2012

CERTIFICATIONS
PMP (2018)
